policy: PanGuard AI signs two kinds of files with separate keys. Audit reports are signed with the key whose usage is audit-report-signing. Technical receipts (per-version test records an evaluator can use as one input to its own assessment; not audit reports, certifications or assurances) are signed with the key whose usage is technical-receipt-signing. Verify offline with: pga report sign verify <file> --expect-key <key_id>. Do not trust a file signed by a key_id that is not listed here, is listed as revoked, or whose usage does not match the file.
